items.title: ‘I am a pretty cautious person’: My financial adviser wants me to invest $350,000 in a UAE data center. Is this risky?
items.description: “I like my life, but I also like the idea of a big return after years of putting money into my 401(k).”

items.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire, yet she wants to take an $8,000 trip to Italy. We have $4 million. Do I keep working?
items.description: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

items.title: Chip stocks suffer worst stretch in 16 months as AI fatigue grips the market
items.description: Anticipation is building for Anthropic’s investor day, as Wall Street grows less patient with heavy AI spending.

items.title: The SpaceX threat could loom over AT&T’s stock for a prolonged stretch, analyst cautions
items.description: Bernstein analyst Laurent Yoon no longer recommends any of the major telecommunications stocks as he warns of more volatility ahead.

items.title: Six Flags’ stock slumps near 17-year low after fatal incident
items.description: A fatal accident on a Six Flags Entertainment roller coaster sent shares of the amusement-park operator tumbling.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile’s stock is feeling the heat from SpaceX’s wireless plans
items.description: AST’s commercial rollout could face delays due to satellite-launch challenges and SpaceX’s growing ambitions, an analyst warns.

items.title: UnitedHealth keeps medical costs under control — and raises its outlook again
items.description: The health-insurance giant said its medical-cost ratio was 88.4% in the third quarter of this year, as the company tries to rein in spending on medical care.

items.title: Was Broadcom CEO bullish or bearish on AI? ‘Gamblers’ comment creates storm.
items.description: The comments made by Broadcom’s CEO at a conference in Singapore have been cited as a reason for microchip stocks’ slumps on both Monday and Tuesday.

items.title: Micron’s stock extends declines as China competition heats up
items.description: Even Elon Musk says Chinese memory-chip makers are catching up.

items.title: My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and now says she deserves the $925,000 family home. Is she right?
items.description: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”
